{{Short description|Mathematical topological manifold}}
In [[mathematics]], a '''fake 4-ball''' is a [[Compactness (topology)|compact]] [[Contractible space|contractible]] topological [[4-manifold]].  [[Michael Freedman]] proved that every three-dimensional [[homology sphere]] bounds a fake 4-ball.  His construction involves the use of [[Casson handle]]s and so does not work in the [[smooth manifold|smooth]] category.

== References ==

* Alexandru Scorpan, ''The Wild World of 4-Manifolds'', American Mathematical Society,  {{ISBN|0-8218-3749-4}}
